item.title: Lady Demon softball program adds D1 transfer to pitching staff
item.description: The Northwestern State softball program has added another talented arm to its bullpen with the addition of a former Delaware High School Gatorade Player of the Year. item.title: NSU softball auction approaching Jan. 24; still seats available for Saturday’s baseball auction
item.description: Northwestern State softball is “Letting the Good Times Roll” once again at its annual auction. item.title: Cartoon of the Week: Campaign Trail Influencer
item.description: These days, the campaign trail doesn’t wind through town halls — it runs straight through your phone. item.title: Letter to the Editor: Litter along Highway 1 causes community concern
item.description: Trash along roadways in Natchitoches Parish has become an increasingly visible problem, and Highway 1 is a clear example of how serious the issue has become. The stretch of Highway 1 from Texas Street to the parish landfill is littered with debris, creating an unsightly and disappointing first impression for residents and visitors alike. item.title: NSU Dept. Head sworn in as newest member of Sabine Parish Tourist Commission
item.description: Dr. Valerie Salter was sworn in at the January board meeting as the newest member of the Sabine Parish Tourist & Recreation Commission. Dr. Salter serves as Department Head and Associate Professor in the Department of Hospitality Management & Tourism at Northwestern State University of Louisiana in Natchitoches. item.title: Temporary Church Street Bridge closure for Christmas light removal morning of January 14
item.description: The City of Natchitoches announced a temporary closure of the Church Street Bridge on Wednesday, Jan. 14 from 8:30 a.m. – 12 p.m. The closure is necessary for the Utility Department to remove the city’s Christmas lights from the bridge. The schedule is subject to change depending on weather conditions. item.title: Special Called Parish Council meeting set for Friday
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Council will hold a special called meeting on Friday, Jan. 16 at 9 a.m. The meeting will take place in the Council Board Room, #211 on the 2nd Floor of the Courthouse. See Agenda
